scope: Independent before/current Realm Gate two-view appearance/contact/architecture/near-route review.

inspection.method: All complete originals opened with view_image; no crops or edits.

before.reason: The left lamp pedestal visibly ends above grass with a dark tree-like form beneath it; the right base and thin brown threshold pieces read at ground level. The gate identity and dirt approach are legible, but the complete entrance has an unresolved left masonry union. Uniform turf/coarse grass and large cliff shelves with sharp dark triangular bands fail full appearance.

current.reason: Both lamp pedestals now have visible stone shafts extending down to the grass surface. Thin brown threshold strips lie at the dirt approach surface. The pointed gate, banners/lamps and approach remain readable. No conspicuous gap beneath the visible lamp bases is present. Broad uniform turf, coarse blade grass and heavily stepped cliff backdrop still fall short of the reference finish.

local_comparisons.reason: Left and right lamp supports read as grounded stone columns rather than the previous incomplete left base. Gate, trainer, bird and dirt route stay legible. No clear new large structural-contact regression is visible.

The left stone shaft is now continuous to the surface and the right remains continuous. Thin brown strips are visually at the ground. The low central doorway/threshold remains partly covered by actors; the rock shelf behind the arch still interrupts a clean view through the opening.

aperture_and_route_limits: A pointed arch is clearly recognizable, but the rock shelf behind it and actors at its foot conceal part of the onward passage. No clear walking continuation, rear threshold, underside or mechanical access proof is supplied.
visible_regressions: No clear new broad contact or route-framing regression in these two images. Actor pose differences are not attributed to a system/source change.
owning_requirement: Coherent reference-backed grounded architecture and readable route/landmark, with intentionally integrated masonry/ground junctions.
limits: Two staged production-camera High1080 stills per set only. No earned arrival, motion, co-op, device, full matrix or whole criterion claim.
No mechanical support, walkability, collision, implementation cause, spacing-system or identity-system inference.
Weather and unchanged actor position are not asserted. Actor silhouettes/poses differ and are judged only as pictured.
No source/config/manifest/log/receipt/private binding/runtime conclusion or numeric grade read. No catalogue rerating.
Original 253bd whole FAIL, five Bridge full-bar FAIL comparisons and previous witnesses remain untouched.
